. Although she had previously not taken any medications, a recent 
visit to the University Student Health Clinic resulted in her being placed on oral contraceptives to

tives, she does not take any medications or supplements.
Family History
Family history revealed that MG’s father takes medication for his blood pressure. Her mother has 
type 2 diabetes mellitus. Additionally, an aunt on her mother’s side has struggled with infertility 
and amenorrhea.
Social History
MG does not smoke or use recreational drugs, and reported only occasional social alcohol use. She 
is in a long-term, monogamous relationship with her high-school boyfriend and they are currently 
living together. Although graduate school is stressful, she reports adjusting well and engages in
